title: Enterprise Attestation v1
description: Cryptographically signed attestation that binds a policy evaluation to an operator identity. Uses HKDF-derived HMAC-SHA256 for local attestation. Designed for later OIDC-based key exchange.

attestation_id.description: Attestation identifier, derived from policy_evaluation_id prefix

policy_evaluation_id.description: SHA-256 hash of the canonicalized policy evaluation this attestation covers

signature_hash.description: HMAC-SHA256 signature over canonical evaluation + operator_id + signed_at

acknowledged_gates.description: Gate IDs that passed and are acknowledged by operator

acknowledged_checks.description: Operator acknowledgement strings that were checked

content_light.description: Always true — no raw secrets, tokens, or vulnerable code
